records.name: Finite relation to digraph realization
nonclaims: This representation theorem does not attach geometry or physical ontology to the graph.
records.statement: For a finite labelled carrier X, G_step=(X,A_step) with (x,y) in A_step iff stepRel(x,y) preserves the one-step relation exactly.

hypotheses: G_step is the exact graph realization of stepRel
records.name: Normality equals zero outdegree
nonclaims: Zero outdegree does not imply admissibility, fixed-point status, truth, or physical stability.

hypotheses: G_step is the exact graph realization of stepRel
records.name: Reachability equals directed path existence
nonclaims: Finite reachability does not establish infinite-path liveness.
records.statement: For finite G_step, y is reflexive-transitively reachable from x iff there is a directed walk from x to y; when x!=y a directed path may be chosen.

hypotheses: G_step is the exact graph realization of stepRel
records.name: Finite termination equals acyclicity
nonclaims: The finite DAG criterion is not a general proof of well-foundedness for arbitrary infinite carriers.
records.statement: On a finite carrier, forward termination of stepRel is equivalent to absence of directed cycles in G_step.

records.name: Finite sink strong-component existence
nonclaims: A sink SCC need not contain a normal vertex and is not a fixed point or termination claim.
records.statement: Every nonempty finite directed graph has at least one sink strongly connected component.

records.name: SCC condensation is acyclic
nonclaims: Acyclic class-level progression does not imply state-level termination inside an SCC.
records.statement: The condensation graph obtained by collapsing strongly connected components of a finite directed graph is acyclic.

records.fixture: parallel labelled arcs u->v versus one unlabelled arc u->v
records.name: Rich-to-simple projection loses arc identity
nonclaims: This is a representation-loss counterexample, not a physical information-destruction claim.
records.statement: Two distinct rich directed multigraph records can collapse to the same simple endpoint-adjacency relation.

records.fixture: M={a,b,c}: chain a-b-c versus triangle a-b-c-a
records.name: Module inventory does not determine incidence
nonclaims: Shared module count or local motif does not select a unique global topology.
records.statement: The same labelled module set can support distinct typed incidence relations.

records.name: Drawing does not determine abstract geometry or physics
nonclaims: A visual embedding may still be useful when its role is explicitly declared.
records.statement: One abstract graph admits multiple coordinate drawings with identical adjacency.
